segments.name: capital equipment
products: ion implantation and other processing equipment
segments.description: Builds ion implantation and processing equipment for chip makers and supports it after sale.
segments.evidence: We operate in one business segment, which is the manufacture of capital equipment for the semiconductor chip manufacturing industry.

revenueModel.text: Semiconductor chip manufacturers buy its equipment and aftermarket parts, upgrades, maintenance and training.
revenueModel.evidence: In addition to equipment, we provide extensive aftermarket lifecycle products and services, including used tools, spare parts, equipment upgrades, maintenance services and customer training.
